all_known_failures_tool_failure.statement: Tool failures occur in all 14 known strict-fail tasks; this association does not establish causation.

answer_return_calls.statement: The 50 verified completed traces contain 50 return_answer calls in total; this does not establish semantic correctness.

outcome_partition.statement: The frozen set has 33 strict passes, 14 known strict failures, 3 unknown strict verdicts, and 6 timeout failures among 56 tasks.

raw_totals_not_rates.statement: Raw call totals across strict-pass and strict-fail groups have unequal group sizes and are not per-task rates.

timeout_counterfactual.statement: The partial logs cannot establish whether earlier stopping would yield a strict pass; timeout remains a failure in the fixed denominator.

timeout_early_log_end.statement: Four anonymous timeout tasks have only 153-238 seconds of completed events in their partial logs despite a 1200-second wall limit; the remaining time is not explained by completed event records.

timeout_heterogeneity.statement: The two late-active and four early-log-end timeouts do not support one uniform observed timeout trajectory.

timeout_late_activity.statement: Two anonymous timeout tasks have completed event spans of 1136 and 1178 seconds within a 1200-second limit, with 50 and 69 completed LLM calls, respectively. This describes activity near the deadline, not whether calls were redundant.

timeout_partial_logs_exist.statement: Each timeout has hash-bound partial LLM and tool event logs, although none has a normalized full trace.

timeout_unfinished_call.statement: Partial logs record completed calls only; an unfinished final call or other process time may explain the unobserved interval, but its type and cause are unknown.

tool_failure_not_sufficient.statement: Tool failures occur in 31 of 33 strict-pass tasks, so their occurrence alone is not sufficient for a strict failure.

tool_failure_types.statement: Trace success flags mark 87 query_db and 100 execute_python calls as unsuccessful; no error content was inspected.

tool_flag_semantics.statement: A tool success flag cannot distinguish expected exploratory errors from errors that obstruct the task.

tool_usage.statement: Traces contain 1077 query_db, 631 execute_python, and 94 list_db calls.

unknown_verdict_gap.statement: The 3 completed tasks with missing strict verdict remain unknown, not known strict failures.
